review.scope: Strict ascending authoring; only own July24 frozen feed, exclusions and card used after July23 saved.
review.timing: Alphabet and Tesla July23 after-hours results treated as eligible; all July23 regular closes explicitly not reactions to those later releases. No July24 releases used as completed events.
review.claims: Reviewed exact headlines and attribution. Commentary labeled commentary; PZU unofficial allegations not promoted to legal outcome. China collateral change not equated to new credit demand. ETF turnover not net flow.
review.markets: Instrument, horizon, completed exchange-local session and units checked. Treasury wording preserved. Crypto uses prior completed UTC daily close. ETHA first close quoted with no invented returns. No numerical spot FX.
review.consistency: Constructive Alphabet/GE/KO, mixed Tesla/Spotify/UPS; conditional expressions and risks consistent across sections.
